recipes.meal_prep: Cool cooked components within 2 hours and refrigerate at 5°C or below. Consume within 1 day. Reheat cooked fish or prawns only once until piping hot; keep cold salad components separate.

method.text: Cook the Quinoa according to the packet instructions; drain well and allow it to steam-dry.
Season the King prawns with the measured garlic, herbs or sauce ingredients.
Cook the King prawns in a hot non-stick pan until opaque, piping hot and cooked through.
Prepare the Courgette, Cherry tomatoes and Baby spinach; cook firm vegetables until tender-crisp and leave salad vegetables raw.
Combine the grain and vegetables with the measured lemon, soy sauce or oil dressing.
Slice or flake the protein, arrange over the bowl or salad, add cheese, nuts or seeds, and serve.

qa_records.message: Direct CoFID-aligned records used for the core ingredients. Prawns are specified as cooked weight for repeatability.
